checks/independent/dfm-symanzik-qed-ae-f.role: Bounded exact cotree-polynomial verification application with owned indexed multigraph topology, exact masks/weights, connected spanning-tree census, conservative arithmetic budgets and Railway query operations
checks/independent/dfm-symanzik-qed-ae-f.cost: V=1..16 vertices, E=0..12 edges and at most4096 masks. Admission owns O(E) topology. Component computation uses O(VE) time and O(V) storage by merging component labels. Tree enumeration costs O(2^E*VE) worst case and stores at most4096 masks. Products use at mostE integer multiplications; a sum uses at most4096*E products and4096 additions. Each input/product/sum prefix is at most4096 bits; temporary multiply/add have at most8192/4097 bits before admission. Default22 obligations =1 three-edge list+10 components+1 tree list+8 monomials+2 sums.

groups.requirement: Admit exact integer weights and intermediates with signed magnitude at most4096 bits, excluding bool/float. Validate exact vertex count1..16 and every endpoint in0..V-1. Own0..12 indexed edges; loops and parallel/oppositely oriented edges are preserved as distinct positions.

Require exact masks0<=m<2^E, rejecting absent high bits and negatives before indexing. Compute connected components by merging complete labels. Enumerate in increasing mask order exactly connected subsets with V-1 selected edges. Preserve the singleton empty tree and disconnected empty census; expose successful values via Outcome.

Admit exactlyE weights including selected or disconnected edges before multiplication/enumeration. Multiply only omitted-edge weights in index order, with empty product1. Sum over connected V-1 edge masks, with no-tree sum0. Check each product and increasing-mask sum prefix even when later zero/cancellation would fit. Accept signed/zero integers as an explicit finite polynomial extension beyond the supplied Lean natural weights.

Require a Cases recorder and count22 actual obligations on the supplied five-edge graph: ten component decisions, exact three-edge/tree lists, eight separate cotree monomials and two sums. Preserve247 and8, emit JSON, exit nonzero for expected check failures, and propagate unexpected programming errors/cancellation.

checks/independent/dfm-symanzik-qed-ae-f.consumer_boundary: Executable path and run/prod helper names retain the supplied graph interpretation. The old helpers silently truncated high mask bits and accepted incomplete weight lists; these now refuse typed input. CotreeGraph deliberately extends the finite executable to owned indexed multigraphs with explicit V/E/bit budgets and signed/zero polynomial weights; those runtime capabilities do not generalize the Lean fixed-graph theorem. Default JSON counts22 actual obligations and preserves sums247 and8. No external Python caller or consumer of old prose output was found. Full Lean origin and derivation note reviewed: QED loop coefficients, alpha and continuum integrals remain outside scope and the scientific DAG stays OPEN. Historical receipts retain original hashes.
